name: Axi Agent Platform
summary: Multi-agent collaboration platform combining a FastAPI backend, React dashboard, SubAgent worktree isolation, an MCP model swarm, and the Axi Todo tool.

entrypoints.purpose: FastAPI application, lifecycle initialization, health endpoint, and REST router registration.
React + Electron macOS glass desktop shell prototype.
MCP model-swarm server and tool registration surface.

setup: python -m venv backend/venv && backend/venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
smoke: PYTHONPATH=backend uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements backend/requirements.txt python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_code_isolation_manager.py backend/tests/test_runtime_api_smoke.py

provides: FastAPI health and system API under /api/v1
macOS glass desktop shell prototype under apps/desktop-glass-ui
Axi Todo CLI and MCP tools
consumes: Git repositories used as SubAgent worktree roots

troubleshooting.symptom: Bare `cd backend && pytest tests/` fails during collection with a missing backend module such as fastapi or pydantic_settings.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: The selected Python environment does not contain the complete backend dependency set.
troubleshooting.resolution: Use the manifest smoke command, or create the backend virtual environment, install backend/requirements.txt, and rerun pytest.

troubleshooting.symptom: SubAgent mode is unavailable while the rest of the API starts.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: REPOSITORY_PATH is missing, invalid, or cannot be initialized as a Git worktree root.
troubleshooting.resolution: Set REPOSITORY_PATH to an accessible Git repository root and review backend startup output.

troubleshooting.diagnosis: The Vite frontend and backend ports or proxy configuration are not aligned.
troubleshooting.resolution: Start the backend on port 8000 for local development or use the Docker Compose ports documented in README.md.

commands: PYTHONPATH=backend uv run --python 3.12 --with-requirements backend/requirements.txt python -m pytest -q backend/tests/test_code_isolation_manager.py backend/tests/test_runtime_api_smoke.py
